extracted.intended_audience: Applicants using Grants.gov workspaces (larger teams, including external contributors such as consultants, grant writers, and sub-applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step advanced approach for creating and managing a Grants.gov workspace for larger teams (including external contributors), assigning roles, sharing forms/subforms, checking for errors, and submitting the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make sure all team members and external contributors have registered with Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Without a Grants.gov account, team members or external contributors will not be able to access the workspace and fill out application webforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For example, if you want seven different individuals to help complete webforms, then all seven should register a Grants.gov account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design an internal application workflow and assign responsibilities to your team members and external contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan who will do what on the application and assign roles so tasks are clear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the interactive workflow graphic and Workspace roles and access chart to design your application plan. Ensure at least one participant has the Workspace Manager role to create the workspace and at least one participant associated with the UEI that owns the workspace has a core AOR role so the application can be submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Log in and create your workspace by clicking Apply on the grant opportunity page
rubrics_metrics.description: Create the workspace from the View Grant Opportunity page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any user with the Workspace Manager role or one of the core AOR roles may create the workspace. The user who creates it will automatically become the Workspace Owner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add team members from your organization as 'Participants' so they can access the application forms
rubrics_metrics.description: The Workspace Owner should add internal Participants to the workspace to allow them to access and complete forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At least one Participant should have one of the core AOR roles so that the workspace can be submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add any additional Participants who are registered with Grants.gov, though not part of your organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Workspace Owners can include external contributors in the workspace as Participants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External contributors must be registered with Grants.gov to be added and to access the workspace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit budget form access to only the Participants who need it
rubrics_metrics.description: Control access to sensitive budget forms to protect confidential financial information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Workspace Owner may restrict budget form access when adding individual participants to the workspace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add subforms to your workspace so that sub-applicants can easily find and complete them
rubrics_metrics.description: Enable and include subforms that are part of some workspace packages so sub-applicants can complete their required portions separately from parent forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A Workspace Owner can access and enable a package's subforms by clicking the Go To Subforms button in the Form Name column on the Forms tab of the Manage Workspace page. After adding a subform, consider changing the form access level for any sub-applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reuse forms from previous workspaces when appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants may reuse individual forms or entire workspaces from prior submissions to save effort.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a form is reused, the information on the form's cover sheet will be updated to match the current workspace. Note that after a form is reused, any data in the new workspace form will be overwritten.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete all required forms and consider locking forms once finished
rubrics_metrics.description: Finish every required form in the workspace; forms may be completed as PDF or webform and users may switch between types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data is synced to the workspace upon uploading PDF forms and upon saving webforms. Grants.gov recommends that the person completing each form locks access to it so others cannot overwrite the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: When all forms have been completed, notify the AOR and submit the application
rubrics_metrics.description: Run checks and follow the appropriate steps to have the Authorized Organizational Representative (AOR) sign and submit the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workspace performs some automatic error checks; run additional checks via the Check Application button. If the Workspace Owner does not have a core AOR role, they may click the Complete and Notify AOR button. Once all forms are in 'Passed' status, the Standard/Expanded AOR may log in and click Sign and Submit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track your application and download the submitted application for offline record-keeping
rubrics_metrics.description: After submission, monitor status and retain a local copy of the submitted application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track the application using the tracking number received from Grants.gov. The Standard/Expanded AOR or Workspace Owner should download a copy of the submitted application, verify the contents of the submission zip file, and the Details tab of the workspace is the recommended place to track and download the application.
